item.name: Register User by Role
item.description: Register a user on Clerk. The role should be lowercase name of role.

item.name: Get Users from Clerk
item.description: Returns details of all users registered on Clerk.

item.name: Get Test Token
item.description:
Creates a test token to be used against authorized routes.
If an email is provided for a registered user, a token is generated for the user associated with the provided email.
If no email is provided, however, a token is provided for the first user found among all the users registered on Clerk.

item.name: Get Own Profile
item.description: Returns details about the user profile associated with the provided authorization token
